correctness.rationale: A 9841-element normalized coefficient space is partitioned by exact 1152-element ambient symmetry into 41 projective orbits, independently checked with all ambient matrices. The discriminant squarefreeness criterion agrees with 164 exact four-chart Groebner tests; the 14 smooth orbit sizes sum to 5184. Two separate implementations agree on all rational point, ramification and deck-composite orders. The geometric deck automorphism is translation by a rational elliptic point, verifying its true order; Hasse and the unique size-576 orbit yield exact sharp bound seven. No finite-search-to-infinite-smoothness inference occurs.

value.rationale: The two degree-two projection maps are intrinsic to a marked elliptic biquadratic and define a QRT translation, making their branch data and translation order natural geometric-arithmetic invariants. A complete joint classification in the smallest odd field gives previously unreported incidence structure and sharp unique maximal seven-cycle orbit; the substantial complete census is not obtained from the ordinary Hasse bound or a textbook computation.
